SUMMARY.md: Civitai API v1 Production Server
Pass your API key as a query parameter
REST API for accessing Civitai creators, images, models, model versions, and tags. Provides endpoints for retrieving specific resources like models by ID or model versions by hash.

The amount of models linked to this user
The blurhash of the image
The date in which the version was created
The date the image was posted
The description of the model (HTML)
The description of the model version (usually a changelog)
The download url to get the model file for this specific version
The generation parameters parsed or input for the image
The height of the image
The id of the image
The identifier for the model
The identifier for the model version
The mode in which the model is currently on. If Archived, files field will be empty. If TakenDown, images field will be empty
The name of the model
The name of the model version
The username of the creator
Url to get all models from this user

Whether the model is NSFW or not
